text:
maria-cs: FYI AcmeCorp just escalated: p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~800ms and p99 hit ~2.4s after we flipped the int8 calibration profile yesterday. They also saw a spike in billed tokens and intermittent 429 auth errors. Can someone triage?

kevin-support: Thanks Maria — can you paste the customer request id or sample timestamp?

maria-cs: Sample request id: req_2026-03-16_19:22:14_acme. Timeline: rolled quant profile to `int8-closed-calib-v3` at 19:00 UTC, anomalies start ~19:05. Link to their app logs: https://acme.example/reports/req_2026-03-16_19:22:14 (customer shared).

opsteam-bot: New alert: high_queue_depth: model=gpt-7b-int8-calib host=cluster-a queue_depth=45 p95_latency=820ms p99_latency=2410ms

devon-eng-runtime: Seeing similar in infra dashboards — a spike in kernel compile/initialization time post-calibration swap, and KV cache priming delays. The int8 compile step kicked off more JIT work for a subset of shards which caused head-of-line blocking.

sanjay-eng-ml: Calibration note: v3 introduces a layerwise per-channel quant schedule that increases warmup passes to gather stats. If warmup concurrency is not limited it can starve GPU for serving batches. That would increase queuing and p99.

alyssa-oncall: Can we reproduce quickly in staging? If it's head-of-line, fallback to fp16 or disable the new profile for a canary subset.

devon-eng-runtime: Repro steps I ran in staging:
```
# simulate customer pattern: many short chat requests with 32 token outputs
for i in `seq 1 100`; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" \
    -H "x-redwood-model: gpt-7b-int8-calib" \
    -d '{"input":"hi","max_tokens":32}' &
done
```
Result: queue_depth climbs, p95/p99 spikes after first few warmup compiles.

kevin-support: Customer also attached a sample API error from their side: `{"error":"rate_limited","message":"too many concurrent inits"}` — that matches compile storms. They complained billing rose 3x because their client retried on failures.

billing-bot: Noted billing spike. I'll flag for manual credit review if this is platform-induced. Please create ticket with timeline and estimated extra tokens.

devon-eng-runtime: Immediate mitigations: 1) toggle their deployment back to `fp16` model variant 2) throttle concurrent calibration workers 3) enable `quant_fallback: true` so any heavy compile falls back to fp16 for warm requests. We can do (1) now for Acme and schedule (2)/(3) as a patch.

sanjay-eng-ml: I can push a quick config change to the calibration service to cap warmup concurrency to 4 per-host. That should reduce queuing. Also add a mode where calibration runs at lower priority (nice value) so serving threads have precedence.

alyssa-oncall: I'm going to start the rollback for AcmeCorp to fp16 variant on their tenant. devon, can you prepare the rollback command?

devon-eng-runtime: Running tenant rollback now:
```
POST /v1/tenants/acmecorp/deployments/rollout
{"route":"/generate","model_variant":"gpt-7b-fp16","rollout_strategy":"immediate"}
```
Status: accepted 202. Will monitor metrics.

opsteam-bot: Action taken: model_variant_change for tenant=acmecorp by alyssa-oncall at 2026-03-16T19:28:10Z

maria-cs: Customer confirmed revert succeeded and p95 dropped to ~140ms within 2 minutes. They still want credits for the extra billing.

kevin-support: Please gather token delta and error/retry counts. Also ask if they were using naive client-side retries.

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BLG-2026-318 with preliminary estimate request. Assigning to billing ops.

devon-eng-runtime: Longer-term: we'll ship a safety policy: when a quant profile increases compile/warmup time beyond threshold X we should automatically run warmup in background with limited concurrency and serve from fp16 until caches are warmed. I'll open an RFC and patch.

sanjay-eng-ml: Also proposing a config flag `calib_priority=background|foreground` and `calib_max_concurrency` with sensible defaults. For customer-managed toggles, add `allow_calib_auto_fallback=false` option if they want to opt into aggressive calibration.

alyssa-oncall: Created incident INC-2026-045 for tracking: impact=AcmeCorp p99/regression and billing spike, severity=high, owner=devon-eng-runtime.

kevin-support: Sent customer a note: "We've reverted your model to fp16 and are investigating the int8 calibration behavior. We'll follow up with credits after billing team review." They replied :thumbsup:.

devon-eng-runtime: Quick follow-up items I will own: - telemetry change to record compile time per-profile - runtime patch to enable `quant_fallback` by default when compile_time > 3s - safe rollout doc for calibration-enabled profiles

sanjay-eng-ml: I'll add a unit to calibration pipeline to measure expected warmup walltime and surface a preflight warning in Console when enabling a heavy profile on shared clusters.

maria-cs: Customer asked for a short RCA and mitigation plan to share with their infra team. I'll draft and share once we have INC notes.

opsteam-bot: Monitoring: cluster-a queue_depth returned to normal after rollback. p95 back to baseline.

billing-bot: Billing ops requested the retry logs and token counts per request id. kevin-support please attach to BLG-2026-318.

kevin-support: Attaching logs now. Also noted one auth 429 was due to their client hammering retries which observed transient compile failures; not a token auth bug on our side but consequences were billed. We'll include guidance: exponential backoff and do-not-retry-on-init.

alyssa-oncall: Closing immediate incident once RFC and follow-up PRs are tracked. tagging devon/sanjay for ownership.

devon-eng-runtime: PRs queued: runtime#482 (quant_fallback default), infra#999 (calib concurrency cap). Expected deploys in next 48h behind feature flags.

sanjay-eng-ml: I'll run a smoke matrix on representative workloads to ensure calibration v3 doesn't regress latency when warmups are capped.

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll update the customer with the RCA draft later today.

kevin-support: Filed CL to docs: add best-practices for toggling calibration profiles and safe rollout checklist.

maria-cs: Customer accepted temporary credits and will wait for RFC before re-enabling int8.

devon-eng-runtime: Summary for thread: root cause = calibration/profile triggered heavier compile/warmup causing head-of-line queueing; customer retries amplified billing and auth 429s. Mitigations = tenant rollback to fp16, cap calibration concurrency, implement auto-fallback to fp16 for heavy compiles, docs + console warnings, billing review ticket.

alyssa-oncall: Marking this thread resolved for support. Follow-up: link INC-2026-045 and BLG-2026-318 in the postmortem.
